title: BYD Just Built a Rolls-Royce Rival. Here's the Catch #shorts

scenes.text: The company famous for ten thousand dollar electric cars now wants to beat Rolls-Royce.
This week in Guangzhou, BYD showed China its new luxury car. A fully electric limousine, about eighteen feet long, with rear coach doors and four seats.
The pre-sale price is about three hundred eleven thousand dollars. A new Rolls-Royce Ghost starts around three hundred seventy-three thousand.
The Ghost burns gas in a V twelve. The BYD has four motors, one in each wheel, and BYD claims ten to seventy percent charge in about five minutes.
The catch: BYD still hasn't shared its power or battery size, and the six hundred mile range is on China's easy test.
Would you pay Rolls-Royce money for a BYD? Tell me below. Follow EV Drive.
